description: The reader's decision about ONE conflicting file: keep one agent's version, or merge the file by hand. The record is a VALUE and the file's path is its key, which is why a surface bound to a list of these can have at most one decision per file: two entries for one path would let the merge request claim two winners for one file. A decision for a path that is not in conflict is ignored by the radar (nothing to decide) but is still carried to the host unchanged, so a host that keeps its own list never loses data on a re-render. Agent requires AgentId; a blank one is REJECTED at construction because "keep the agent's side" without an agent would pick a winner by accident.

members.name: Decides
members.description: Whether a decision stored under path settles that file.

members.name: AgentId
members.description: The winning agent's id, or null for a manual resolution.

members.name: IsAgentSide
members.description: Whether this decision picks an agent's version.

members.name: IsManual
members.description: Whether this decision hands the file to the reader.

members.name: Kind
members.description: Whether one agent wins or the reader merges the file by hand.

members.name: Path
members.description: The conflicting file's path, normalised the same way Path is.
